title: Next.js Application Generator
description: Create a complete Next.js application with server-side rendering, API routes, TypeScript setup, and optional authentication and HTTP client configuration.

name.description: Name of the application (e.g., web, api, dashboard). Creates apps/[name]/ with full Next.js application structure.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this application?

directory.description: Override the directory where the application will be created (default: apps/ creates apps/[name]/)

useAxios.description: Setup Axios HTTP client with interceptors in lib/axios/ for API requests

useAuth.description: Setup NextAuth.js authentication with route handlers and providers in lib/auth/

orgName.description: Organization name for scoped import paths (e.g., @myorg creates @myorg/[name] path alias)
